claim: Fix an integer \(n\ge4\). In the single-excitation XY model of Casaccino--Lloyd--Mancini--Severini on the complete graph \(K_n\), all off-diagonal couplings have Hamiltonian weight \(2\), and the two designated input/output vertices receive the same positive energy shift \(\Delta>0\). Put \[\alpha(\Delta)=\sqrt{4n^2-4(n-4)\Delta+\Delta^2},\qquad \beta(\Delta)=\frac{\Delta-2n}{\alpha(\Delta)}.\]Then perfect state transfer between the shifted vertices occurs if and only if \(\beta(\Delta)=p/q\) in lowest terms for integers \(q>0\), \(|p|<q\), with \(p\) and \(q\) of opposite parity. In that case all positive perfect-transfer times are exactly \[t=\frac{2\pi q}{\alpha(\Delta)}(2s+1),\qquad s=0,1,2,\ldots.\]Equivalently, all positive perfect-transfer shifts are \[\Delta_{p,q}=\frac{\left(2p+\sqrt{2nq^2-2(n-2)p^2}\right)^2}{q^2-p^2},\]with the same coprimality, size, and opposite-parity conditions. This set is countable and dense in \((0,\infty)\). The source's tuning \(\Delta=2n\) is exactly the case \((p,q)=(0,1)\), not the only positive shift producing exact transfer.

correctness.rationale: The exact invariant decomposition gives a leakage condition \(\sin(\alpha t/2)=0\) and then a single phase congruence \(e^{-i\pi k\beta}=(-1)^{k+1}\). In lowest terms \(\beta=p/q\), this congruence is solvable exactly when \(p-q\) is odd, with all solutions \(k=q(2s+1)\). The positive-shift inverse map and density follow algebraically; finite reduced-dynamics checks agree.

value.rationale: The theorem completely solves the natural one-parameter control problem left by the source construction: it gives every positive equal shift that produces exact transfer, every transfer time, and shows these exact tunings are dense. It is useful for design and for separating arithmetic exactness from robustness, while retaining the original physical coupling network.
